text:
lia: Heads-up — onboarding weights landed at s3://redwood-models/onboard/llama-cust-1/v1. Quick follow-up: tokenizer is inserting an extra BOS between system+user segments with our chatpad template; causes off-by-one in the KV cache and sometimes early EOS.

omar: Ugh. Is that only for the non-merged tokenizer updates or seen on main too?

lia: Seen on main and on the quantized build. Repro steps: system prompt (no trailing newline) + user message -> token stream contains <s> at the boundary.

lia: Example (tokens simplified):
```
[<s>, SYS: Hello], [<s>, USR: What is the plan?], ... -> extra <s> token between brackets
```

sasha: That rings a bell — I saw a similar gap when we ran chatpad templates with models that include an explicit BOS in the tokenizer special tokens. Might be double-BOS handling.

matt: Could be the chat template sanitizer adding a leading space which triggers a new token? We had a bug where leading whitespace produced a separate token for some bpe tables.

jen: Can you try setting trim_bos: true in the serving config and retest quickly? If that fixes it we can add a validation rule.

lia: I tried trim_bos:true and it fixed the extra token but broke a few evals where the model expected an explicit leading token for system messages (edge cases).

omar: Ok — two options: 1) keep trim_bos but insert an explicit virtual BOS in the template for those evals, or 2) keep BOS and change chatpad sanitizer to avoid adding space/newline. Which is lower risk?

lia: Option 2 is safer for backwards compat. I pushed a small sanitizer fix in PR #4321 — it normalizes trailing newlines instead of inserting spaces.

sasha: Linking PR — #4321 looks clean. Also noticed q4 and q8 quantized variants have slightly different token boundaries for emojis and some punctuation. Might need per-variant tokenization fingerprinting in our onboarding checklist.

matt: Agreed. We should compare tokenizer.tokenize('⚡️') across variants as part of model validation. If differences are found, fail the onboarding with a warning and require explicit ACK.

lia: Added a lightweight check to tokenizer CI to compare token counts for a small prompt set across variants. tokenizer-ci: can you run it on the new weights?

tokenizer-ci: CI started for s3://redwood-models/onboard/llama-cust-1/v1 — tests: special-tokens, chatpad-template, bos-eos-consistency.

(tokenizer-ci later): CI ✅ special-tokens and bos-eos-consistency passed; chatpad-template failed on variant q4. See logs: s3://redwood-logs/tokenizer/1891234567/q4-failure.log

omar: Log says: token_boundary_mismatch on message id 17: expected 4 tokens but got 5. Screenshot in logs.

jen: For the failed variant, we can auto-map the pad_token to eos and rerun. Quick patch in serving config: 
```
model_config: {
  pad_token: "",
  pad_token_behavior: "map_to_eos",
}
```

matt: That mapping reduced token count delta in local repro. But we need to be explicit in the onboarding doc so customers don't get surprising outputs when they pin variants.

lia: I'll update the onboarding checklist in the docs repo with: weights path, tokenizer-fingerprint diff, recommended pad_token mapping, and a note about trim_bos consequences.

omar: Also add a rollforward: if chatpad-template test fails, auto-fallback to the non-chat template route for hosted until variant is fixed. Keeps production apps online.

lia: Added fallback policy to the model router config and bumped the canary threshold.

sasha: Can someone review PR #4321 and the onboarding doc change? cc @omar @matt :eyes:

omar: Reviewing now, aim to merge before EOD.

matt: Quick code review done — left one nit about the test name.

jen: I’ll prep a small eval to ensure no quality regression for the system-turns once we merge.

lia: Thanks all. After merge I’ll kick off a full onboarding run and post final pass/fail with the log links. :thumbsup:
